label: APC Rack PDU 2G Switched 30A/208V (21xC13 3xC19)
description: Zero-U switched rack PDU for a 208 V three-phase rack feed: 30 A input on a NEMA L21-30P cord, 21 C13 and 3 C19 outlets with per-outlet switching plus branch and total current metering, 8.6 kW capacity. One 10/100BASE-T RJ45 network port carries the Web UI, SNMP and CLI, and the In/Out Network Port Sharing jacks let up to four 8000-series PDUs sit behind a single IP address.
notes: Front panel of the AP89XX switched PDU (user guide 990-5569K-001) lists a '10/100 Base-T Connector', 'Network status LED', '10/100 LED' and reset button - so the management port is Fast Ethernet, not Gigabit. The same guide documents 'DHCP and BOOTP configuration', hence dhcp-client. The In/Out Network Port Sharing jacks are an RJ45-terminated PDU-to-PDU bus (terminator required at each end), not an Ethernet segment, so they are not modelled as ports. Discontinued Jun 2022; the 9K-series APDU9965 (21 C13/C15 + 3 C19/C21) is the replacement, and per APC's rack PDU family spec the 9000 series is the Gigabit-Ethernet generation while 8000-series units stay at 10/100.
